description.value:
Warforged are mechanical beings built as weapons for the Last War. An unexpected breakthrough made them sentient: though made of wood and metal, they feel pain and emotion.

Warforged combine organic and inorganic materials. Root-like cords soaked in alchemical fluids serve as muscles, wrapped around a frame of steel, darkwood, or stone, and armored plates form a protective shell and reinforce the joints. The more a warforged develops a personality of its own, the more likely it is to have an artificer customize its face, limbs, and plating.

Warforged Traits

Creature Type: Construct

Size: Medium (about 6–8 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

Speed: 30 feet

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.AvJXWEGvpeRPqzRZ]{Construct Resilience}. You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the &Reference[Poisoned] condition.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.dBAnTYbEtzQiTPEK]{Integrated Protection}. You gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class. In addition, armor you have donned can't be removed against your will while you're alive.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.ZxrJaMNMS2qSeXaI]{Sentry's Rest}. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 6 hours if you spend them in an inactive, motionless state; during this time, you appear inert but remain conscious.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.YE6NRSL2ST1dMB6w]{Specialized Design}. You gain one skill proficiency and one tool proficiency of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.species.Item.acBEgRglBRC6iHRi]{Tireless}. You don't gain Exhaustion levels from dehydration, malnutrition, or suffocation.
